name: nkia-codex-skills
description: Codex skills for NKIA development, Linear, Confluence publishing, review, and reporting workflows.

interface.shortDescription: NKIA development, Linear, review, and reporting skills
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for NKIA-AI Linear planning and updates, task start, design-driven implementation, SonarQube remediation, commits, PR/MR review and shipping, evidence validation, weekly reporting, and Markdown-to-Confluence publishing.
defaultPrompt: Use $feature to define a parent Linear feature.
Use $task to create child implementation tasks.
Use $sonarqube-pass to restore a repo SonarQube quality gate with Linear evidence.
Use $code-review to validate a GitHub PR or GitLab MR.
Use $finish after PR/MR merge to clean branches, register evidence, validate AC, and roll up Linear status.
Use $weekly to prepare the weekly report.
Use $confluence-md-upload to publish Markdown reports to Confluence with diagrams preserved.
Use $develop-from-design with a design document to implement and verify its scope.
Use $linear-issue-evidence and $linear-issue-validator to register and verify AC evidence.
